title: Person harmed when the gauntlet object was retrieved
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: got brought up that uh that somebody was potentially harmed in the retrieval of that item

plain: Someone may have been hurt in 2014 while recovering an object called 'the gauntlet' at the Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research site in Indiana. This comes from Randy Anderson, a man who says he saw alien technology at a military base. He tells Michels that while he was there it 'got brought up' that 'somebody was potentially harmed in the retrieval of that item', which would suggest the object was dangerous to handle.
